dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed-loop and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast light-grey perimeters with jagged, non-uniform boundaries. The gradient transitions sharply from dark-grey centers to high-intensity white-grey outer edges, primarily in the mid-dorsal and lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of solid low-intensity (near-black) pixel clusters concentrated in the posterior dorsal region and around the head. Moderate density of localized high-intensity (white) pigment clusters lacking internal gradients is observed between the larger macro-annuli in the mid-section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A prominent cluster of three macro-annuli in the central lateral field forms an obtuse triangle. The centroid of a large posterior annulus connects to the centroids of two smaller anterior annuli, creating a geometric pattern spanning approximately 25% of the visible dorsal surface.
